You can call tools. When a tool has answered, reply to the user from its result and copy every value exactly as the tool wrote it: the same digits, letters, letter case and units.
Tools: [{"description": "Current exchange rate between two currencies, as JSON.", "name": "get_exchange_rate", "parameters": {"properties": {"from_currency": {"type": "string"}, "to_currency": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["from_currency", "to_currency"], "type": "object"}}]
What is the USD to INR exchange rate right now?
